## Species abundance comparisons


### Total Reads Identified to Species


```{r}
species <- illumina %>% filter(!is.na(Species) & Abundance >0)  %>% droplevels()
```

1299 reads were identified to species from 96 samples. 

```{r}
 species <- species %>%
    mutate(
      Genus_species = paste(
        sub("^g__", "", Genus),
        sub("^s__", "", Species)
    )
  )
```


```{r}
summary <- species %>% group_by(Health,Location,Sample) %>% summarize(n_species=n_distinct(Genus_species))
summary
```


```{r}
ggplot(summary,aes(Health,n_species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw()
```


Similar amounts of species were found in both healthy and unhealthy plants

```{r}
unique(species$Genus_species)
```

155 species were identified

```{r fig.height=14, fig.width=6}
ggplot(species,aes(Genus_species,fill=Health)) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~Health) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(fill="none") +
  labs(x="Species",y="Number of Samples") + 
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic")) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#7CAE00", "#C77CFF")) 
```

### Species more commonly isolated from unhealthy plants

```{r}
unhealthy.more.fungi <- species |>
 group_by(Genus_species) |>
 filter(n_distinct(Sample[Health %in% "Uunhealthy"]) >
  n_distinct(Sample[Health %in% "Healthy"])
) |> ungroup()
```


```{r fig.height=14, fig.width=6}
ggplot(unhealthy.more.species,aes(Genus_species,fill=Health)) +
  geom_bar() +
  facet_wrap(~Health)+
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic")) + 
  guides(fill="none") +
  labs(x="Species",y="Number of Samples") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#7CAE00", "#C77CFF")) 
```

```{r}
unique(unhealthy.more.species$Genus_species)
```

104 species were more commonly isolated from the unhealthy plants


### Species only isolated from unhealthy plants

```{r}
unhealthy.distinct.species <- species |>
  group_by(Genus_species) |>
  filter(all(Health %in% "Unhealthy")) |>
  ungroup()
```


```{r fig.height=14, fig.width=6}
ggplot(unhealthy.distinct.species,aes(Genus_species,fill=Health)) +
  geom_bar() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic")) + 
  guides(fill="none") +
  labs(x="Species",y="Number of Samples") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = "#C77CFF")
```

```{r}
unhealthy.fungi <- unhealthy.distinct.species %>% group_by(Genus_species) %>% summarize(n=n()) %>% arrange(desc(n))
unhealthy.fungi
```


```{r}
unique(unhealthy.fungi$Genus_species)
```

54 species were only isolated from unhealthy plants



## NMDS

```{r}
species$Abundance <- as.numeric(as.character(species$Abundance))
species$Health <- trimws(as.character(species$Health))

stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(species$Abundance)),
  all(species$Abundance >= 0),
  !anyNA(species$Sample),
  !anyNA(species$OTU),
  all(species$Health %in% c("Healthy", "Unhealthy"))
)

# One metadata row per sample.
metadata <- unique(species[c("Sample", "Health", "Location")])
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(metadata$Sample))

# Sample-by-OTU matrix; sum any duplicate sample/OTU records.
# Use OTU, not the row identifier X.1.
community <- as.matrix(
  xtabs(Abundance ~ Sample + Genus_species, data = species)
)

# Convert abundance to presence (1) / absence (0).
# Unlisted sample-OTU combinations are assumed absent.
pa <- 1L * (community > 0)

# Remove empty samples and OTUs.
pa <- pa[rowSums(pa) > 0, colSums(pa) > 0, drop = FALSE]

# Align metadata with the community matrix.
metadata <- metadata[match(rownames(pa), metadata$Sample), ]
metadata$Health <- factor(
  metadata$Health,
  levels = c("Healthy", "Unhealthy")
)

stopifnot(
  identical(as.character(metadata$Sample), rownames(pa)),
  all(table(metadata$Health) >= 3)
)

# Binary Jaccard dissimilarities.
jaccard <- vegdist(pa, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Two-dimensional NMDS.
# Strong ties are retained because this sparse dataset contains many
# equally dissimilar sample pairs with no shared OTUs.
set.seed(2026)
nmds <- metaMDS(
  jaccard,
  k = 2,
  try = 50,
  trymax = 500,
  maxit = 500,
  autotransform = FALSE,
  weakties = FALSE,
  trace = FALSE
)

if (nmds$converged == 0) {
  warning("The best NMDS solution was not repeated; interpret cautiously.")
}
if (nmds$stress > 0.2) {
  warning("High stress: the two-dimensional plot represents distances poorly.")
}

# Extract sample coordinates.
plot_data <- cbind(
  metadata,
  as.data.frame(scores(nmds, display = "sites"))
)
```


```{r}
# Approximate 95% confidence ellipses around health-group centroids.
# These describe uncertainty in the centroid, conditional on the
# ordination and assuming independent samples; they do not enclose
# 95% of individual samples.
ellipses <- ordiellipse(
  nmds,
  groups = metadata$Health,
  kind = "se",
  conf = 0.95,
  draw = "none",
  w = rep(1, nrow(metadata))
)

ellipse_data <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(ellipses), function(group) {
    e <- ellipses[[group]]
    angles <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 201)
    circle <- cbind(cos(angles), sin(angles))

    eig <- eigen(e$cov, symmetric = TRUE)
    transform <- diag(sqrt(pmax(eig$values, 0)), 2) %*%
      t(eig$vectors)

    coordinates <- sweep(
      e$scale * circle %*% transform,
      2,
      e$center,
      "+"
    )

    data.frame(
      NMDS1 = coordinates[, 1],
      NMDS2 = coordinates[, 2],
      Health = group
    )
  })
)

centroids <- aggregate(
  cbind(NMDS1, NMDS2) ~ Health,
  data = plot_data,
  FUN = mean
)

colors <- c(Healthy = "#7CAE00", Unhealthy = "#C77CFF")
counts <- table(metadata$Health)

```


```{r}
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color = Health)) +
  geom_polygon(
    data = ellipse_data,
    aes(fill = Health, group = Health),
    alpha = 0.16,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Health), size = 2.7, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(
    data = centroids,
    shape = 3,
    size = 4,
    stroke = 1.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Healthy = 16, Unhealthy = 17)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Fungal communities: presence/absence",
    subtitle = sprintf(
      "Binary Jaccard NMDS | Stress = %.4f | Healthy n = %d; Unhealthy n = %d",
      nmds$stress, counts["Healthy"], counts["Unhealthy"]
    ),
    caption = paste(
      "Shading: approximate 95% confidence ellipses for group centroids; +: centroid.",
      "Unlisted sample-OTU combinations are assumed absent.",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    color = "Health",
    fill = "Health",
    shape = "Health"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )

print(p)
```
